notes: Pins the WebRTC-enabled Horizon (miyoubi/horizon 9a64e6563, 'build: allow native mods to use WebRTC') so a bundle crate may declare rtc, plus horizon-mixins d9c83d7 for the [[crate]] schema.
That revision is not in horizon-rust/horizon, so the launcher must reuse a cached native/source/<revision> tree.
When moving to a newer Nightly, update horizon_revision here and in the manifest, and refresh source_sha256.
